name: Pohang city hometown patch (포항시 패치)
verdict: Pohang City's hometown patch on the right sleeve of the 2026 home kit, alongside the Woori Bank WON sponsor patch. Nothing found.
note: Sleeve patch on Pohang Steelers' 2026 home kit: the K League's 2026-02-10 kit-launch article says the right sleeve carries sponsor Woori Bank's new WON patch and the Pohang city patch together; the club store's '2026 리그 패치 SET' product shows the set contains the WON sponsor patch, the '연고지 패치' (POHANG artwork) and the K League patch. Rating note: a municipal government of South Korea; state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md), and no sourced record against Pohang City found.
